findings.detail: The issuer_name field concatenates country/sector wrappers and separate Type of Investment, Investment Date, Maturity Date, and Interest Rate columns instead of retaining the clean Portfolio Company issuer.

rationale: C206 is confirmed. In the raw schedule, the header separates Portfolio Company, Type of Investment, Investment Date, Maturity Date, and Interest Rate. For table 23 row 5 the source Portfolio Company cell is only Nexii Building Solutions, Inc. (10), with loan type, dates, and rate in separate cells; the stored issuer_name instead concatenates the Canada/Construction Technology wrappers plus those separate row terms. Table 23 row 17 shows the same structure for another flagged row, confirming a parser extraction gap rather than a valid issuer value.
